title: The blanket's last wash
logline: The blanket on the line in February, the worn corner now a hole, the light through it. Twenty-seven years of dogs. The page draws the light through the hole and takes the blanket down in the next page it doesn't draw.

panels.composition: A wool blanket pinned on a clothesline in February with a hole worn through one corner and light showing through it, the garage door beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a wool blanket pinned on a clothesline in February with a hole worn through one corner and light showing through it, a garage door beyond, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
